llm_response.reason: The website exhibits multiple scam indicators: an unnaturally broad range of products (including secondhand, luxury, electronics, books, home goods) unlikely to be legitimately offered together, ambiguous or missing business and privacy information, lack of legitimate or professional contact info, refusal of returns, no evidence of product authenticity, and no working hyperlinks. The domain is nonstandard and the site text appears generic or scraped. WHOIS lookup failed, suggesting an attempt to hide true ownership. These are hallmarks of fake shopping scam websites.
